name: Billing, Payments & Finance
summary: Invoices that send themselves, payment reminders that get paid, and books that close on time.
description: Cash flow problems are often process problems: invoices that go out days late, reminders nobody sends, failed card payments nobody notices, and month-end closes built on spreadsheets. These automations connect the moment work is finished to the moment it is billed, follow up on unpaid balances politely and consistently, recover failed payments, and keep finance data reconciled as it happens.
